Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring record checks for fire fighters.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to fire fighter record checks; adding a new sectionto chapter 41.08 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 52.30 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: For all paid or volunteer fire fighters, hired or appointed afterthe effective date of this act, that may, in the course of their workor volunteer activity for a city or town, have access to the home orproperty of another person, cities and towns shall require a recordcheck through the Washington state patrol criminal identificationsystem under RCW 43.43.830 through 43.43.834, 10.97.030, and 10.97.050and through the federal bureau of investigation before hiring anemployee or accepting a volunteer. The record check shall include afingerprint check using a complete Washington state criminalidentification fingerprint card. The requesting entity shall providea copy of the record report to the applicant or volunteer. Whennecessary, as determined by the city or town, applicants and volunteersmay be employed on a conditional basis pending completion of theinvestigation. If the applicant has had a record check within the p. 1 SSB 6441previous twelve months, the city or town may waive the requirement uponreceiving a copy of the record from the applicant or volunteer. Thecity or town may in its discretion require that the applicant orvolunteer pay the costs associated with the record check.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 52.30 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: For all employees or volunteers, hired or appointed after theeffective date of this act, that may, in the course of their work orvolunteer activity with the district, have access to the home orproperty of another person, fire protection districts shall require arecord check through the Washington state patrol criminalidentification system under RCW 43.43.830 through 43.43.834, 10.97.030,and 10.97.050 and through the federal bureau of investigation beforehiring an employee or accepting a volunteer. The record check shallinclude a fingerprint check using a complete Washington state criminalidentification fingerprint card. The requesting entity shall providea copy of the record report to the applicant or volunteer. Whennecessary, as determined by the fire protection district, applicantsand volunteers may be employed on a conditional basis pendingcompletion of the investigation. If the applicant has had a recordcheck within the previous twelve months, the fire protection districtmay waive the requirement upon receiving a copy of the record from theapplicant or volunteer. The fire protection district may in itsdiscretion require that the applicant or volunteer pay the costsassociated with the record check.
